body.p: A sturgeon and a pike. Once a sturgeon and a pike quarelled. The pike bit the sturgeon with its sharp teeth.[ShA:] Nagezi is unclear and never attested, so I replaced to the phonologically similar item with She immediately sailed back. It is not easy to bite a sturgeon. Now the pike was laughing, scaring all the fish: "I'm the strongest pike."the necessary meaning.[ShA:] PiinaÄ and nixuta are both unexpected forms here. The sturgeon understood that it cheated the fishes. The sturgeon started fighting with the pike. The sturgeon beats the pike with its rough body. It hurts the pike. It got afraid and ran away. Then the sturgeon shot an arrow from a bow at the pike. A sharp arrow hit the pike's back.[ShA:] Nominative dÊ¼odazu is unexpected, lative case is expected. Now the pike's bones diverge on two sides.[ShA:] Lizida is an unexpected form, liziza is expected.
